aiMetadata.description: Sends a Segment Identify call that associates a user (by required userId) with a set of traits, registering or updating that profile in Segment. Use when an agent needs to record who a user is and their attributes for downstream analytics/tooling. Not idempotent: each call emits a new Identify event.
